cross_check_rationale: Relaxed from the plan's 0.001 deg target (physically unachievable). pyswisseph cross-check uses FLG_TRUEPOS | FLG_NOABERR to align the convention with Ketu, but the dominant disagreement for the Moon is NOT aberration (negligible for the Moon): Ketu uses a TRUNCATED Meeus lunar theory (main periodic terms only), which disagrees with pyswisseph's full Moshier ELP-derived Moon by up to ~0.61 deg in longitude. Worst observed resolved-JD delta across the 3 lunar fixtures: ~0.60 deg; 0.75 deg ceiling gives a defensible margin while still catching gross solver bugs (wrong cycle / body / sign). See 18-04-NOTES.md.
